notes.title: Shadows of Larth
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32854465/06e708d6b6dc8b4c7a0bc6d0b88e5d4af1d9af00.jpg[/img]

Greetings SOY community,

Today I'm sharing with you the upcoming release of my second title, Shadows of Larth.
An action game with a core combat mechanic based on a triple stance motion, that you can use to combine deadly attacks.

The game will offer a unique experience regarding combat, exploration and upgrade systems as the following : 

[list]
[*] An Epic fantasy Story inspired by Medieval to Bronze age Mediterranean culture
[*] Unique visuals crafted and digitally sculpted by hand with realistic and dynamic lighting
[*] Fluid and fast paced combat system tested and built as the "Core Game Mechanic"
[*] Diverse world and enemies, explore cities,forests,ruins,dungeons ...
[*] 8 directional dodge and roll even when you are locked on to a target
[*] RPG Dialogue narratives with multiple choice with each NPC you meet
[*] Up to 15 Marked Ability to unlock
[/list]

Please don't hesitate to support this title and wish-list before launch on February the 20th
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1137030/Shadows_of_Larth/]Steam Store Page[/url]

notes.title: Update 1.1.0
notes.content:
A new update is live now with a full mechanic plus abilities as the following:

[h1] Sprint Plus [/h1]
By holding [b] "Shift"[/b]  or [b] "RT"[/b]  you can now sprint faster .

[h1] Power Slide [/h1]
By Pressing [b] "ALT"[/b]  or [b] "RB"[/b] while on ground or jumping will boost slide you up
toward the direction of your choice.
[b]Boost Slide while jumping is more powerful.[/b]


[h1] Trial Helper [/h1]
For certain trials you will find the [b]Blue Stones[/b], if you find the trial too hard, you can kneel before the Stones and the Trial will be auto-solved and the gates will open.
[b]Using the trial helper will not grant you the Steam Achievement related to that trial.[/b]


[h1] Reset to Last Checkpoint [/h1]
If you are stuck and you want to go back to the last checkpoint you can now press [b]"R"[/b] or [b]"Y"[/b] on the Controller to reset back.


[h1] Localization full rework [/h1]
The localization has been reworked completely from scratch, with an additional culture [b]"Simplified Chinese"[/b].

[b]In the hope that your Yalmrith Experience become even better and more fun[/b]
